name: Depth Spelunking
desc:
[ DISCLAIMER: This game is still in a beta stage. You will likely encounter many bugs, some unfinished content, and the balance will not be perfect. Everything is subject to change ]

Delve into the depths of a decaying world deep within the void, where reality shatters, hostile monsters lurk, and death is never the end to one's suffering. Trapped in an endless cycle, you must endure, adapt, and push forward—toward the bottom of the bottomless abyss, where answers may lie hidden... or where nothing at all awaits you.

Inspired by Minus Elevation by Vanilla Deluxe
More information: [ https://devforum.roblox.com/t/1637069 ]
